content.overview: Article 82 requires that upon the completion of each census, the allocation of seats in the House of the People to the States and the division of each State into territorial constituencies shall be readjusted by such authority and in such manner as Parliament may by law determine. Amendments have deferred fresh inter-State readjustment of seats until after the first census taken after the year 2026.
content.glance: After each census: readjust LS seat allocation and constituencies as Parliament by law provides. Inter-State seat freeze until post-2026 census.
content.study:
Article 82 links Lok Sabha composition (Article 81) to demographic change. Parliament provides by law for the authority and manner of readjustment. Constitutional amendments (notably the line associated with the 42nd and 84th Amendments) have frozen the allocation of seats among States based on earlier census figures until the first census after 2026, while allowing delimitation within States under applicable law.

Examination: state the census trigger; Parliament’s power to prescribe authority and manner; note the post-2026 freeze on inter-State seat reallocation.

sections.heading: Core rule
sections.body: After each census, allocation of LS seats to States and division into territorial constituencies shall be readjusted as Parliament by law determines. Current freeze: inter-State seat numbers held until after first census post-2026.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 82 provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 82 requires that upon completion of each census, the allocation of seats in the House of the People to the States and the division of each State into territorial constituencies shall be readjusted by such authority and in such manner as Parliament may by law determine. Inter-State allocation of seats is currently frozen until after the first census taken after 2026.

examTips: Census → readjustment; post-2026 freeze on inter-State seats.

keyTakeaways: Art 82: post-census readjustment; inter-State freeze until post-2026 census.
